newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Mabuhay sharply down in early trade.
newsitem.headline: Mabuhay sharply down in early trade.

text.p: Philippine's newly-listed Mabuhay Vinyl Corp shed 12 centavos, or 6.19 percent, to 1.82 pesos on Thursday as investors feared it could go into a steep decline, brokers said.

"I think its because yesterday the stock's performance was quite disappointing closing only slightly above its IPO price and since people were not so sure that its IPO price will hold, they continued to sell," said Teresa Lee, assistant vice-president at Lippo Securities.
Mabuhay closed at 1.94 peso on Wednesday despite a debut price of 2.18 pesos. Its offer price was 1.90 peso.
